application.name: PaperLens — AI-Powered Research Paper Agent
application.description: Autonomous academic research agent that ingests research papers, analyzes them across 7 core dimensions, extracts clean Mermaid.js system architecture flowcharts, and synthesizes 3 resume-ready student development projects with code starter packs.

agentConfiguration.highAvailabilityStrategy: Dynamic multi-tier model failover with automatic 429 quota backoff and built-in offline benchmark exemplars
agentConfiguration.promptingStrategy: Few-Shot In-Context Learning with Structured Schema Guidance

fewShotDemonstrations.paperTitle: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
fewShotDemonstrations.focus: Weight decomposition matrices, memory reduction, zero inference latency, adapter merging

fewShotDemonstrations.paperTitle: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
fewShotDemonstrations.focus: GPU SRAM block tiling, online softmax normalization, IO complexity, CUDA kernel optimizations

sevenAnalysisDimensions.name: Research Objective
sevenAnalysisDimensions.description: The primary research goal or scientific thesis investigated by the authors.

sevenAnalysisDimensions.name: Problem Statement
sevenAnalysisDimensions.description: The foundational computational bottleneck, theoretical impasse, or memory scaling problem addressed.

sevenAnalysisDimensions.name: Primary Methodology
sevenAnalysisDimensions.description: The concrete algorithmic, architectural, or mathematical formulation introduced.

sevenAnalysisDimensions.name: Key Findings
sevenAnalysisDimensions.description: Empirical and theoretical benchmark results explicitly validated in the publication.

sevenAnalysisDimensions.name: Limitations
sevenAnalysisDimensions.description: Failure modes, environmental assumptions, or architectural boundaries explicitly acknowledged by the authors.

sevenAnalysisDimensions.name: Possible Research Gaps
sevenAnalysisDimensions.description: Unexplored domains, extreme scale scenarios, or modality combinations open for subsequent investigation.

sevenAnalysisDimensions.name: Future Research Directions
sevenAnalysisDimensions.description: Promising theoretical and engineering trajectories highlighted for future exploration.

architectureFlowchart.requirements: Explicitly charts inputs, parameter transformations, hardware memory hierarchies, and model outputs without markdown fences inside the string.

provenanceAndIntegrityGuard.rule: Strict distinction between paper-stated facts and agent proposals.
provenanceAndIntegrityGuard.zeroHallucinationPolicy: Never invent paper authors, benchmarks, or citations. Missing abstracts are transparently flagged as unavailable in the context.

cachingAndPerformance.sessionCache: Client-side and server-side in-memory hash maps (24-hour TTL)
cachingAndPerformance.arxivMetadataCache: Automatic memoization of arXiv XML responses to prevent rate limits
cachingAndPerformance.concurrencyProtection: Monotonic request IDs with AbortController cancellation for stale response rejection

security.clientExclusion: No API keys are exposed to the browser or bundled client-side.
